use_action.msg: You turn off the large closed loop extractor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The large closed loop extractor's batteries need more charge.

data.description: A makeshift extraction system.  It's pretty much just a 55gal drum, a pipe to stir the solution, and a faucet at the bottom to drain the extractor.  Not the most ideal piece of equipment but it will work.
Filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, separating more solids out than quantitative filter paper but the process takes longer.
Filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, separating less solids out than qualitative filter paper but the process is much faster.
A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

use_action.msg: You turn on the vacuum pump.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The vacuum pump's batteries need more charge.

data.description: A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

use_action.msg: You turn off the vacuum pump.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The vacuum pump's batteries need more charge.

data.description: A medium-sized vacuum pump designed to recover solvent (hydrocarbons) from extracted essential oils.
This is a tank of compressed butane.  It can be used to extract essential oils from organic material.
This is a tank of compressed hydrogen gas.  If you need to make water from scratch, or lift a zeppelin, it could come in handy.
A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.
This is a tank of compressed nitrogen gas.  Nitrogen is useful for its lack of reactivity.  Don't try to breathe it.
A large steel cylinder used for storing pressurized gas.  It is marked with a faded, but legible O2 symbol.
This is a metal grille with a layer of platinum plating, suitable for use as a catalyst for some chemical reactions.
This is a rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.
This is a kit for a teleporter trap consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You place the telepad.

data.description: This is an experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.
A briefcase with built-in laptop that looks like it's from the 80s.  Its vintage monochrome monitor displays a plethora of meteorological data.  No sign of the FLDSMDFR, however.

This hefty kit contains some basic things you should probably not try to do precise chemistry without: namely, a small balance scale, a spectrophotometer, a melting point apparatus, a pH meter, and a set of paper for thin layer chromatography.  This makes it a lot easier to feel confident that the chemical you've made is what you think you've made.
This is a simple scale that uses a set of steel weights on sliding bars to measure a sample's mass quite accurately.
This ubiquitous analytical chemistry tool measures the light absorption of a liquid sample in a special tube called a cuvette.
This is a small box filled with precisely calibrated square plastic tubes for laboratory spectrometer use.
This is basically a pair of glass probes on a voltmeter.  By putting one probe into a calibration solution (conveniently included) and the other in a substance, you can calculate the acidity.
This device has two probes that let you measure the electrical potential between two points.

This is basically a hot plate, with a metal housing attached.  The metal housing has a magnification viewport and a slot into which a capillary tube containing a crystallized sample is inserted.  The device lets you precisely measure the melting point of a crystal, a property very useful in identifying what it is and how pure it is.

This is a small, hefty, boring looking machine.  Its weighted trapezoidal frame has a single on-off switch and a speed dial, and on top of it sits a rubber receptacle.  Pressing a test tube into the receptacle would, with power, rapidly shake and mix the contents of the test tube.  It's surprisingly fun to use.
This is a photodiode on a chip, designed to convert incoming light to electrical energy for quantification.
This is a high quality crystal glass prism for separating and redirecting light.
This is a small glass tube.  What more could you possibly want to know about it?
data.//: Volume here is displacement volume of a corked 25mL test tube.

data.description: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  Without electricity the light doesn't work, but the rest of it is surprisingly functional.  Unfortunately it's not useful for very much at the moment.

This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3d image of the surface.  It was typically used for doing dissections and other fine detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?

This thing doesn't look much like a funnel.  It's a teardrop shaped piece of glass with a stopper at the wide end and a valve at the other.  It can be used to wash one liquid with another, like water and an oil, and then draw off whichever of the two liquids contains a higher amount of whatever compound you're trying to isolate.  With a high level of skill it can also be used to make juvenile farting noises.
A tall glass column with a stopcock at the end.  If you're serious about chemistry, you probably have a tattoo of one of these somewhere.

Just looking at this thing makes you feel like a proper mad scientist.  It's a series of glass tubes and round flasks, connected to a central motor and a heating element.  The heating element warms one flask, kept rotating by the motor, evaporating the contents.  The vapour is then condensed in the tubes and collected in another flask, in case you wanted to save it for later.

One of the classic pieces of mad science glassware, this is basically a small volume still that passes the vapour through a fractional distillation column and then condenses the distillate in a cooled collection column.  A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.

This is a set of plastic trays, electrodes, and a power supply designed to create an electric voltage gradient through a liquid solution containing a solid gel.  Stuff like proteins and DNA would then get separated on the gel according to electrical charge and size.  Pretty useless now, for anything but salvage.

This is a smaller, benchtop version of the larger furniture-sized centrifuge.  Don't be fooled by its portable scale; it's still a very powerful piece of equipment that can spin stuff really quickly.  It's not a toy!
Stop giggling.  This is a tiny plastic valve, get your mind out of the gutter.
A plastic box with holes in it.  Not that exciting, unless you're desperate for a place to store a test tube.  Then it's great.
A plastic tray riddled with small holes, for storing microcentrifuge tubes.
This is a heavy metal plate and a sturdy rod, for clamping lab stuff to.

This is a small box with a jumbled assortment of clamps for mounting on ring stands.  There seems to be some sort of rule that all of them are missing at least one wing nut for tightening them; it looks like judicious use of twist ties, duct tape, and other random stuff has been used to compensate.
This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.  This shelter has been damaged, and needs repairs.
This is a family sized tent.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.
This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.
This is a small personal tent, it's just big enough to fit you comfortably.
An advanced version of the electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.
This is a fine glass tube with a bulb with a bowl on one end.  It's used to partake of certain illicit substances.
This is a hand-blown glass pipe.  It's of the type most commonly used to smoke recreational substances.
This is a hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate consumption of fire cured tobacco leaves.
A stapler for fastening sheets of paper together.

This metal tool can help you punch a single hole in a piece of paper.  I mean, you could do more if you wanted, but you'd have to do them one at a time.  Or, if you really wanted more holes with one punch, I suppose you could fold the paper…  This is a one cylinder hole puncher.
This sterling silver letter opener resembling a small dagger has a sharp point and no cutting edge.  It was used to open mail envelopes neatly and quickly.
These are a long pair of heavy-duty scissors.  Use scissors to cut items made from cotton (like clothing) into rags.
This is a fine pen, of much better quality than a disposable model.
Sharpened HB #2 graphite pencil, equipped with an eraser.
Disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Shares the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This pen is black.
Disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Shares the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This pen is blue.
Disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Shares the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This pen is red.
Disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Shares the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This pen is green.
A leather-back journal for preserving notes and maps, has a strap to keep loose pages contained.
A thick short bone, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.
A thick short wooden stick, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.
A thick blunted wooden stick.  Can be used to drill rough holes in rock, if water and sand are available, but the process is lengthy.
A thick short bone with a small pointy tip, usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.
Two pieces of wood with a steel nail secured inbetween them with some cordage.  Usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.
This is a crude sharpened bone awl; those were used for leatherworking before metal was discovered.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.
This is a steel awl with a wooden grip, usually used for leatherworking.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.
A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.
This is a rather bulky and primitive wooden frame which can be used to weave cloth sheets.  It is very slow, though.
This is sharp needle made from a bone.  It would be useful for making rough clothing and items.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.

A curved sharp needle made of steel.  Its rounded shape allows it to make stitches that only pierce one side of the material.  While unsuitable for most tailoring projects, it's a necessity for stitching neoprene.

This is a wooden needle whittled down to a sharp point.  It has a narrow hole carved into the head for threading.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision, or involving tougher materials like Kevlar.

This is a plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or reinforce that clothing.  This uses your tailoring skill.
This is a short thin flat wooden stick, used as a tool while weaving cloth with a frame loom.
A treated animal hide which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning leather hide and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning leather hide isn't done yet.
use_action.//: 2 days

data.description: A treated animal pelt which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning fur pelt and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning fur pelt isn't done yet.
use_action.//: 2 days

data.description: This is a large set of tailoring patterns made from paper.  They're useful for making any kind of cloth or leather items from scratch, but are necessary for more advanced projects.

This is a high quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, and an awl.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.
This is a small bathroom scale, meant to weigh a person while naked.
This is a simple scrub brush.
This is a dish towel, useful for cleaning hard surfaces.

snippet_category.text: An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  Unfortunately, they aren't your initials.
An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  It even has your initials!
A well used dish towel, judging by the stains.
A novelty dish towel, featuring a popular children's cartoon character.
A novelty dish towel which reads "IT'S WINE O CLOCK".
A dish towel with a floral pattern.
A dish towel with a gingham pattern.
A dish towel with a cat pattern.

data.description: This is a pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 10 units of charge per use.
This is an unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.
This is a largish piece of cloth, useful in crafting and possibly for staunching bleeding.
A double-edged razor blade.
This is a compact and lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.
A sponge is a tool or cleaning aid made of soft, porous material.  Typically used for cleaning impervious surfaces.

snippet_category.text: A round smiley face sponge.
A rectangular sponge with a green abrasive back.
A natural sea sponge.  It looks kind of lumpy.
A dolphin shaped sponge.  It looks at home in the water.
A rectangular sponge.
A sponge cake shaped sponge, the abrasive pad looks like frosting.
A sponge in the shape of a beloved character from a children's cartoon.
A cat shaped sponge.

data.description: This is a kit with tools for cutting hair.
This is a makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.
This is a wooden washboard.  You can use it to wash filthy clothing if it's supplied with cleansing agent.
A combination kit of a washboard and a scrubbing tool.  Everything you need to clean items after the apocalypse.

This is a spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the beartrap.

data.description: This is a machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

use_action.done_message: You set the blade trap %d squares away.

data.description: These are several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.

data.description: This is a crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set up and watch some poor bastard trigger it.

use_action.done_message: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.

data.description: This is a sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

use_action.done_message: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.

data.description: These are small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.

data.description: These are glass shards glued together to expose their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the glass caltrops on the %s.

data.description: This is a simple tripwire, which is attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single round can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

use_action.done_message: You set the crossbow trap.

data.description: This is a military anti-personnel mine that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You set the land mine.

data.description: This is a simple tripwire is attached to the trigger of a loaded double slamfire shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires.  Two shells are loaded; the first time the trigger is pulled, one or both shells may be discharged.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

data.description: This is some thin strong cable with some affixing tools on either end.  A tripwire trap must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  Its purpose is to trip up trespassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tripwire.

data.description: This is a large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.
This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.
This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, zombies, or in an emergency, pizza.  The blade, while effective in combat, is hard to hit with due to its small size.

use_action.msg: You turn on the circular saw.

data.//: Circular saw would be very fast but imprecise butchering tool - alas the qualities are not separate and so speed is sacrificed.
data.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.
This is a decent-sized chunk of worked copper affixed to a wooden shaft, to make a crude yet effective axe.
A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon until the wooden haft breaks, and is useful both for chopping things and for use as a hammer.
This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.
This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
This is a broad piece of stone with an edge narrow enough to roughly chop wood.
This is a chunk of steel with one edge hammered down to something resembling a cutting edge.  It works passably well as an axe but really can't compare to a proper axe.
This is a stone adze, somewhat useful for smoothing wood objects.
This is a stone with a narrow edge affixed to a stick.  It can chop wood, but requires much more effort than a modern axe.
This is a thin saw, useful for cutting through wood objects.
This is a primitive short chisel made from hard stone, usually used for primitive woodworking.
A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable.

use_action.msg: You test the bricks, and they're solid enough to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The bricks are still too damp to bear weight.
use_action.//: Should be about a week. Irl it's ten days, so make big batches.

data.description: A pallet of humble mud bricks that have dried for a week, while you were out risking your life.  Disassemble it to retrieve your frame and building supplies.
This bulky device takes water and calcium carbide and yields unpressurised acetylene.
This widespread powertool is often used for removing excess material or polishing surfaces.
This is a portable charcoal-fired kiln.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.
A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.
A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.
This clamp is useful for keeping things still, especially if you have several of them.

This is a small prying tool with a clawed bend at one end for pulling spikes.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.
A portable concrete mixer.  It is still large and heavy, but it can be operated solo, and runs on batteries.  It also has a heater built in.
This is a cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.
A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.
This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on a cell compatible with UPS.  Use it to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.
This is a sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

This is a demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and two by fours in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.
A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow and it will exhaust you quickly.
This is a flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting, or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.
A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.
A poorly constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.
A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.
This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

This is a portable electric kiln, powered by batteries.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.
This is a complete toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.
This is a crude hammer made from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.
These tools are commonly used to remove small amounts of materials from the surface of metal objects.
This metallic tool is most often used to smooth concrete, or mortar, in construction projects.

This is a portable toolkit, consisting of a small carving knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape, it can be used to repair certain items.
This is a plastic mold.  It could be shaped and used to craft items made of plastic.

data.//: The multi-tool is a bit more of a toolkit than a knife.
data.description: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.

A compact tool kit intended for welding and cutting metal, this portable oxyacetylene torch includes a torch handle and cutting attachment in an easy-to-carry tote.  It requires connecting to pressurized cylinders of an appropriate welding gas before use.  In addition to its metalworking uses, you can activate it in order to destroy metal barriers.
A wide brush, suitable for painting walls.
This is a large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!
Handheld pin reamers of this kind are used to enlarge existing holes, or remove any burs and such from them.
This is a basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything too complex will require a wrench.
An electric polisher which can be used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.
This is a rock affixed to a stick, in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one, and can't pull out nails either.
This is a Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.
This is a set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.
This is a portable toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 100 charges of battery power per use.
This is a device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  You could also use it to cauterize wounds, if you had to.

A steel rod bent 90 degrees with a socket on the shorter end, made to hold the lug nuts of a car's wheels to either fasten or loosen for convenient removal and replacement.  Makes for a decent melee weapon in a pinch.
This is a stout metal box for containing tools.  It has a handle on the top and a latch on the front.
This is a stout metal box for containing tools.  It is much bigger than a regular tool box and could be used to store more tools than usual.
Your toolset, protruding from your hands.  It can slice, dice, and make everything nice.
data.//: Charges will exceed max charges since they're always equal to the player's bionic power, but this has no adverse effects.

data.description: This is a battery powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

This crude arc welder has been fashioned from a few small transformers, some wire, improvised electrode holder and complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory welder, it will serve in a pinch.
This large makeshift tool is used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.
The natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed to the felt patches or yarns.

This is a small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to hit things with it.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.  It is too small to butcher corpses with.
This is an adjustable crescent wrench.  It could be a decent melee weapon, and is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.
This is a hose made out of leather.  Watertight and flexible, it can be used to siphon fuel from a vehicle tank.  However, it's not as elastic as a rubber hose.
This is a makeshift manual drill made out of pipe and improvised drill bit.  It is very slow and it will exhaust you quickly.
A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.
A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge survivors.

First aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleedings, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

First aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleedings, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

data.//: A folded bandana still takes up some space on the head.
data.description: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.
Industrial grade ear plugs.  They fit inside the ear.
A huge duffel bag with backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  Judging by the feel, a National Guard soldier could have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.
A huge duffel bag with backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  You have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.
A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.
A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge people.
This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  Using this will turn the flashlight on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.
This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  The flashlight is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to push it up your head.

use_action.msg: You push your %s up your head.

While it is surprisingly handy for vacuum-sealing as well as dehydrating food, the cheery sales pitch neglected to mention A - how awkward the damn thing is, B - That you still need a normal kitchen and C - how it doesn't take batteries.  You're going to have to weld it to a vehicle, or something else with a supply of electricity, if you want to use it.  In addition to the food preservation features, it also has a food processor, a water-purification system, a drawer for holding extra tools, and for some insane reason, a press and die set for hand-loading ammunition.

onpause_buffs.description:
Through the perfect application of the Thrusting Fingers form, you can strike your opponents' weak points, force them away, and follow!

Accuracy increased by 20% of Perception, Enables "Straight Punch (Knockback)" and "L-Hook (Knockback)" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: AKA "drunken boxing," Zui Quan imitates the movement of a drunk to confuse the enemy.  You gain a passive dodge bonus and accuracy bonus based on your intelligence.  Moving gives you additional dodge attempts and each time you dodge, you inflict more damage with your counterattack for until the end of your next turn.
initiate: You begin to sway to and fro with a confident swagger.
%s stumbles as if pretending to be drunk.

static_buffs.name: Zui Quan Stance
static_buffs.description:
Others might think you stumble about at random but you know better.  Each movement is calculated to make evading harm easier.

Dodging Skill increased by 15% of Intelligence.

static_buffs.name: Advanced Zui Quan
static_buffs.description:
You have a greater understanding of Zui Quan.  Your skills at dodging and landing attacks are much better as a result.

+1 Dodge attempts, Accuracy increased by 15% of Intelligence.

onmove_buffs.name: Drunken Stumble
onmove_buffs.description:
With a few quick steps, you can completely change your orientation and dodge additional attacks.

+2 Dodge attempts.
Lasts 3 turns.

ondodge_buffs.name: Drunken Dodging
ondodge_buffs.description:
Each time you dodge, your positional advantage increases against your opponents.  This makes your attacks hit harder with each successful dodge.

Gain Armor Penetration equal to 25% of Intelligence.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 4 times.

data.description: A secret martial art used only by developers and cheaters.
initiate: You get ready pwn some zeds!
%s prepares to cheat at martial arts!

static_buffs.name: Elemental resistance
static_buffs.description: +Strength bash armor, +Dexterity acid armor, +Intelligence electricity armor, +Perception fire armor.

oncrit_buffs.name: Lightning Strike
oncrit_buffs.description: Lightning strikes twice.  +Perception electric damage for 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onmiss_buffs.name: Getting Angry
onmiss_buffs.description: When I get my hands on you…  +2 bash damage for 2 turns.  Stacks 5 times.

onkill_buffs.name: On Fire
onkill_buffs.description: YOU ARE ON FIRE!  +5 fire damage for 5 turns.

data.description: A modern combat style for the post-modern human.  Nicknamed "Biojutsu", Bionic Combatives combines integrated weaponry, armor and augments into an consolidated fighting discipline.
initiate: BEGINNING BIONIC COMBATIVES PROGRAM.  INITIATING COMBAT PROTOCOLS.
%s starts moving with swift robotic precision.

static_buffs.name: Biojutsu Stance

onkill_buffs.name: Optimization
onkill_buffs.description:
>10 LOCATE TARGET
>20 EXECUTE TARGET
>30 GOTO 10

+1 Accuracy, +2 all damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

data.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Zhang Yiaotian.  Centipede Style uses an onslaught of rapid strikes.  Each attack you land increases your attack speed.  Critical hits increase your damage further.
initiate: You ready yourself to attack as fast as possible.
%s assumes a centipede-like stance.

onhit_buffs.name: Centipede's Frenzy
onhit_buffs.description:
Your attacks are a blur of hands and legs that become faster as your strike your opponents without rest.

-4 move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 4 times.

oncrit_buffs.name: Centipede's Venom
oncrit_buffs.description:
Your venom burns your opponents at the worst of times.

+2 bashing damage.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Meng Tianxia.  Lizard Style focuses on using walls to your advantage.  Standing near a wall provides a large bonus to Dodge skill and moving near a wall gives a large bonus to accuracy.  Stronger techniques are enabled when near a wall.
initiate: You ready yourself to attack from any angle.
%s assumes a lizard-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Lizard's Cunning
static_buffs.description:
By briefly scaling, leaping, or pushing off a nearby wall, you can avoid the worst of your opponents attacks.

+3.0 Dodge skill when near a wall.
Enables "Lizard Tail" and "Lizard Wall Counter" techniques when near a wall.

onhit_buffs.name: Lizard's Venom
onhit_buffs.description:
Your venom is a long lasting pain that your opponents will never forget.

+2 bash damage.
Lasts 4 turns.

onmove_buffs.name: Lizard's Leap
onmove_buffs.description:
By briefly scaling, leaping, or pushing off a nearby wall, can attack downward at unsuspecting opponents.

+3 Accuracy when near a wall.
Lasts 3 turns.

data.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Gao Ji.  Scorpion Style is a mysterious art which uses pincer-like hands and a stinger kick.  Moving enables a stunning pincer attack.  Critical hits do massive damage and knock your opponent back along with anyone your opponent comes in contact with.
initiate: You prepare to capture and sting your foes.
%s assumes a scorpion-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Scorpion's Venom
static_buffs.description:
Your venom is a constant threat that nothing can escape from.

+2 bashing damage.

onattack_buffs.name: Scorpion's Intimidation
onattack_buffs.description:
Nothing is scarier than an angry scorpion.  Your attacks can keep others at bay.

+1 Dodge attempts.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmove_buffs.name: Scorpion's Charge
onmove_buffs.description:
Rush forward and catch your prey!

+10% damage.
Enables "Pincer Strike" technique.
Stacks 2 times.  Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Liang Shen.  Masters of Toad Style can focus themselves to protect against all attacks.  You have powerful armor against physical attacks, though you will lose focus when you move.  You can meditate by pausing, giving yourself more armor for a short time.
initiate: You pause for a moment and focus on your invincible body.
%s assumes a toad-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Toad's Iron Skin
static_buffs.description:
Your body is as strong as iron but only if you don't move.

+6 bash, cut, and stab armor.
static_buffs.//: FWIW, this is twice the amount of armor provided by bionic plating.

onmove_buffs.name: Iron Skin Dissipation
onmove_buffs.description:
Moving causes you to lose your iron skin.

-1 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 6 turns.  Stacks 6 times.

onpause_buffs.name: Toad's Meditation
onpause_buffs.description:
By concentrating for a moment, you can bolster the strength of your iron skin.

+3 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 2 turns.

ongethit_buffs.name: Toad's Venom
ongethit_buffs.description:
Your venom is just another lesson about the strength of your iron body.

+2 bash damage.
Lasts 5 turns.

data.description: A legacy of the Five Deadly Venoms, use by Qi Dong.  Viper Style (originally called Snake Style) has a unique three-part combo, which initiates on a dodge, then follows up with a stunning Viper Bite and then finishes with the legendary Viper Strike.
initiate: You prepare to strike your foes' weaknesses.
%s assumes a viper-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Viper's Patience
static_buffs.description:
Every snake waits for the perfect moment to strike.  Turn your opponents' mistakes into your opportunity to strike!

+1.0 Dodge skill.

ondodge_buffs.name: Viper's Ambush
ondodge_buffs.description:
Your evasiveness has left your opponent wide open to painful bite.

Enables "Viper Bite" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

ondodge_buffs.name: Viper's Venom
ondodge_buffs.description:
Your venom is a harsh reminder to never tease a predator.

+2 bash damage.
Lasts 3 turn.

data.description: A domesticated descendant of junglefowl, it may still be the most numerous bird in the world.  Before the Cataclysm, it was raised by humans as a source of meat, eggs, and early morning wakeup calls.
A very common game bird, these creatures remind you of what a wild chicken must have been like.
A small, elegant black bird, famous for its distinctive call.  An intelligent bird, there is a glitter of mischief behind its eyes.
A mallard duck, often seen around rivers and other bodies of water.  It feeds primarily on insects, seeds, roots, and, pre-Cataclysm, bread scraps.
A Canadian goose, a common waterfowl that regrets leaving Canada.
A large and colorful game bird native to the forests of North America.  Its head and beak are covered in fleshy protuberances.
A medium-sized game bird that can have bright feathers depending on the sex and species.
This strange mutant bird gains its name from its odd appearance.  Although its features seem to be becoming more reptilian, it doesn't appear dangerous.
A tiny yellow and brown chick, it could be from a number of different species.
A strange tiny chick, it could be from a number of different species.
A tiny yellow and brown waterfowl chick, it could be from a number of different species.
A horrible bird grown three or four times bigger than ought to be possible and sporting a swollen gut that might look comical if it weren't for the razor sharp beak and the madness in its beady eyes.
This may have once been a crow or a raven, but now it's a deformed monstrosity nearly the size of a man.  It heaves its sable bulk awkwardly along the ground, too overfed on carrion to fly.

Pigeons are gentle, plump, small-billed birds with a skin saddle (cere) between the bill and forehead.  All pigeons strut about with a characteristic bobbing of the head.  Because of their long wings and powerful flight muscles, they are strong, swift fliers.

A robot body with the head of a human.  All kinds of electronic wires and devices are implanted in its head.  Patches of skin look diseased or rotting.  This cyborg moves erratically and has a confused and deranged look in its eyes.

A human fused with a mess of metal parts and wires.  While its eyes are empty, flashes of pain pass across its face reminiscent of the person trapped in this grotesque body.  With enough surgical skills one might be able to give them back some humanity.  If only they cared…
This is a mostly humanoid robot equipped with various construction tools.

This enormous quadrupedal robot seems to be cobbled together from parts, most of them unfamiliar to you.  It moves with a heavy, oddly graceful gait, its footsteps leaving shallow craters behind.  It bristles with an arsenal of weaponry, but doesn't seem in a particular rush to target you.

A mix of dead human and even deader technology, this twisted mess of steel and flesh moves like a puppet in the hands of an angry toddler.  Its robotic components seem to have shut down, and new bands of flesh have wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  Bits of metallic skeleton and armor plating jut from its decaying flesh.

One of the many models of armored law enforcement robots employed shortly before the collapse of civilization.  Solar powered like many other robots, it maintains its programmed pursuit of law and order, propelled on a trio of omni wheels.

Nonviolent riot-control bot.  Designed to suppress riots and make mass arrests of those participating.  Though its relaxation gas is by far its best-known weapon, it carries a blinding flash and a low-powered stungun for self-defense--in addition to its supply of electronic handcuffs.
A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.
A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M202A1 FLASH.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.
An insectoid robot the size of a small dog, designed for home security.  Armed with two close-range tazers, it can skate across the ground with great speed.
This robot looks like a large metal spider, a bit bigger than a person, with its thorax covered in tiny holes.  An ominous buzzing emanates from it.

The single glowing eye of this robot surveys the landscape periodically, as it performs the endless slaughter dictated by a misinterpreted and cruel routine.  Between half-built plates, you can see the machinery and cables that animate it, and yet it moves deftly as it switches between one target and the next.

The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The bright green-and-yellow paint marks a low-force variant - *comparatively* low-force, anyways - typically deployed as guards after an area has been cleared.

The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The dark green paint job marks the lethal and feared military variant, carrying extreme and deadly firepower.

An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have some C-4 inside.

An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have a grenade inside.
An automated anti-personnel drone, a small quadcopter robot surrounded by whirring blades.
Many times as large as a normal manhack, this flying quadcopter drone appears to have a mininuke inside.  If this is targeting you…  Run.

This unusual contraption looks like a combination of a weather balloon and a quadcopter.  Beneath the crude box containing its components hangs a small articulated rig wielding an integrated rifle.  Its propellers flicker to life briefly, then shut down again, keeping it mostly stationary despite the air currents.  It looks capable of hanging in the air for quite a long time before running out of power.
