This once-canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  Devoid entirely of flesh, this walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.
Huge swollen zombie dog, smeared black with slime.  Its teeth are longer and its broad back is rippling with muscles and oozing wounds.
A four-legged canine body now grotesquely swollen, with arms as wide as a trash can and massive exposed teeth.
This is a four legged creature covered in fused bony plates, shaped somewhat like a dog or wolf.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with black goo.

This once-canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  Devoid entirely of flesh, this walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.
This cougar's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its fur is torn, revealing deep festering wounds.  Its claws and teeth are unnaturally long and sharpened into dangerous looking spikes

A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombear's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the surrounding air.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is the outline of a large, shambling cat.
A sickly-looking dead dead black bear with patchy fur.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.
This once great moose's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

What once was a great moose is now covered with long, matted hair twisted with thorny vines that wrap together and then twist back into the body.  Long interlocking thorns wrap the antlers, dripping with a mysterious silvery liquid.
Once a normally-aggressive, normally-hungry bull shark, this jawed terror is now even more of the same, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.
The deformed, animated corpse of a canine; a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.
A zombified version of one of the German Shepherd dogs used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.

death_drops.//: 40% chance of an item from group dog_cop

data.description: An acrid smell accompanies this canine corpse.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.
A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating its vicious-looking white fangs.
This black bear's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.
A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.
data.//: 1d8->2d5, minor bonus over 1d9

data.description: This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, and inside, its gore-stained ribs are clearly visible.  Its most prominent features are the fearsome incisors and thick, black goo in its mouth that it seems proud to display.  It doesn't look interested in chewing on trees anymore.

This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection which is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast, suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.
An otherwise normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.

From the looks of this zombie horse's ghastly features--its protruding ribs, off-white skull, and decayed, tattered muscles--it doesn't seem like it should put up much of a fight, but its mutant strength gives it power.  Black, reeking ichor drips from its wounds.
This otherwise normal-looking tiger stumbles and sways, its jaws slack, its eyes wide open and shining black.
Once a placid cow, this leathery horror stumbles and shudders, its pulsing black eyes scanning for prey beneath wicked horns.  It is big and heavy and murderous.

death_drops.//: 25% chance of an item from group cow

data.description: This enormous, massive creature with oily black eyes and dread horns was once a domestic bull.  Its nasty character makes it attack everyone it meets with tremendous speed and an unbridled rage.

A pale, stumbling, white-tailed deer, rivulets of slime running down its neck.  Its limbs twist and bend in unnatural, haphazard directions, and yet it moves with uncanny strength and speed.  Thanks to the Cataclysm, it has now turned the tables; what was once prey, now itself preys on coyotes, wolves, and giant mutated spiders.
Thousands, maybe millions of spiders piling up high, each slowly oozing sticky green pus, struggling to keep the fetid mass together and moving.
A once-majestic caribou, this undead creature barely resembles the reindeer of tradition and seems to only be interested in human flesh.
A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

death_drops.//: cloth as any other zombie (always), additional items from group hive (sometimes)

data.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.
A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of riot gear.
This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.

The foulest stench is in the air,
The funk of forty thousand years,
And grisly ghouls from every tomb,
Are closing in to seal your doom!

The dancer doesn't even notice you, it seems like something nearby is controlling it.
Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.
A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.
This zombie's face and body is completely covered by a protective suit.  It wanders around, unsteadily.
A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.
This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front.
Once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.
This zombie is rather sleek and barely clothed.
This zombie looks beefed and is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie crawler bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.
This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie bursts, and shadowy winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: It moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies, but can leap a significant distance.
data.//: In the future, it would be nice if these guys could be resistant to fall damage.

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, thin rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to truly fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.
data.//: Slow at actual movement, made up for by its rapid leaps.  This should work to simulate its clumsy form.  When charge attacks are possible it should get one, and that will be its main damaging ability.

data.description: This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a sheer jagged spike.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it was made of human parts.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged pointed object.
This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike and a bloated fleshy belly.
This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow.
A sickly-looking dead one.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

This body has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated body.  It clumsily moves around, but attacks with a large reserve of acid.

special_attacks.description: The corrosive zombie spits a glob of acid!

data.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.
A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Several junks and waste materials have unified into its skin and wounds around it reeks in black goo.
data.//: Higher weight from attached junks.

data.description: A deformed, sickly-looking animated corpse of a canine.  A dangerous-looking yellow saliva drips from its mouth.
A huge canine with multiple large foul looking blisters covering its body.  A corrosive liquid spills from its menancing-looking mouth.
A tiny charred body, jumping and kicked and flailing around in a mockery of playground exercise.  It does not need a face for you to feel bad about killing it.
Charred zombie with bony plates, spikes and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.
Heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred flesh.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.
This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

death_drops.//: default zombie children clothing (always), additional items from child_items (sometimes)

data.description: What was once a child is now a mutant beast with blackened skin and massive eyes.  This abomination's vile form makes mockery of its human origin.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful looking spasms as it runs about.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This swollen, gooey looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge black eyes and its fingertips end in sharp claws.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from what you can only guess was 'research'.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.
A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

This once-human is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.
data.//: slow walk speed - intimidating!
data.//2: melee damage is quite weak since the shockfield around it is its most dangerous function

data.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sometimes, you can see sparks of electricity around it.
A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid pink sludge dribbles from its mouth.
This boomer, normally swollen and ready to burst, has strengthened and solidified.  The bile dribbling from its mouth also appears to have changed…
A huge bloated zombie that appears to have fed upon gasoline; fumes and flames escape from its mouth and fuel leaks from its waddling form.
With its gray skin swollen to near rupture with putrid gas, this cyst covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.
A zombie impaled with a multitude of metal fragments that are covered with a thick layer of rust that seems to propagate to other parts of the body.
Jagged fragments of rust-bitten metal have fused into this zombie's flesh and displaced parts of its spine.
Ruptures in this zombie's skin expose fragments of metal arranged like armor underneath.  Black sludge can be seen in places where the rust has receded.
A spiked horror of a zombie covered in long rusty spikes.
This brute of a zombie is covered in rusted metal detritus.  Chunks of metal smashed through its arms have deformed them into hammers.
data.//: Higher weight from attached junks.

data.description: A conglomeration of human parts fused together in a horrible mishmash of function, slowly dragging its eldritch body across the ground.
Human bodies fused together into a colossus with heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body.  You may have trouble estimating its healthiness and its capabilities might change.

A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emergent from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may already be, you feel certain that this is just part of a creature much bigger, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as if an unseen giant struggled against the weight of its concrete tomb.
Immobile from grievous wounds, its gray skin has bloated to near rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your walking with empty, black eyes.
A nightmarish spidery abomination, born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.
A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.
A nightmarish spider of gore stands tall among the ruins, and keeps silent watch of the blighted landscape.  Its spindly limbs of bone slip between the rubble with otherworldly speed.
Great snakes of flesh hang from the ceiling above, madly thrashing and reaching about.
A great pile of merged bodies and mutated flesh.  It spasms in an arrhythmic and desperate manner.
A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.

Apart from the jet-black eyes, this zombie looks less decomposed and inhuman than most.  Clad in a tattered lab coat, it seems to have a glimmer of awareness - not a human awareness, but something more sinister.  As you watch it, its movements look almost marionette-like.
data.//: zombie scientists are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system

data.description: A shambling human corpse wearing a gray uniform and bulletproof vest with "SECURITY" emblazoned across the front.  It looks like the guard was quite physically fit before its death; it moves quickly and powerfully, albeit clumsily.
data.//: guards are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system

data.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It walks and stumbles in stuttered way, and is granted tenuous corporality only by grace of the experimental gear inherited from its past life.

special_attacks.monster_message: The skulker shifts and melts inwards before disappearing!

data.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It unnaturally skitters on four bone-plated spikes, its every motion trailing an aura of energetic distortion.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shrike shifts and disappears amidst an electric surge!

data.description: A large, bulbous creature with an extremely large mouth and small, stubby legs with no feet.  It is covered in an oily greenish-black residue and large, white pustules that seem ready to pop.

special_attacks.monster_message: Some of the pustules pop, and the frog mother opens her mouth and vomits tadpoles!

data.description: The only resemblance this creature bears to a tadpole is its slick black-green skin and its slender body.  Its three appendages, resembling long tentacles or pseudopods, propel it across the ground at a maddening speed.  It has no outward sensory organs or a mouth, and steam rises from its skin as if it is burning away its own lifeforce to catch you.
A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile-like snout, dripping with foul-smelling saliva.

data.//: This is the brainless zombie.  Has nohead flag to reflect the head is already catastrophically damaged.  Only detects through hearing.
data.description: A zombie like any other, except that its facial features and skull have been devastated.  It's unclear what caused the damage, but between the scraps of flesh you can see that its face and brain are gone, though its ears remain intact.
data.//2: Weight and volume reduced to reflect missing head parts.  Based on average headsize/weight, but are not exact.
data.//3: Lower hp to reflect previous damage.  Plus they're virtually useless so might as well make them a quick kill.
data.//4: Removed Bite attack to reflect damage to mouth.

data.description: Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.
A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  Seems eager to strangle the life from you.
Somehow this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  Very agile for such a large zombie.

data.//: Upgraded version of brainless.  Regenerating Skull with huge ears.
data.description: The head of this zombie was once obviously destroyed, the gaps in its scraps of face now filling with a peculiar gray goo.  Human ears hang from the sides, enormous and unsettling.  Thin slits at the front suggest it may be able to see.
data.//2: Weight and volume changed to reflect a (mostly) lack of head.
data.//3: Removed Bite as this creature does not have a 'mouth'.

data.description: A deformed human body, once living.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.
An undead humanoid, its elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunch from the swollen back and shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

Black hollow eyes survey the surroundings as the zombie stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only thing that seems solid on this flexible, black-veined body is the rows of sharp, black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one might wear clothes.
A human body now swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as a trash can.
This once-human body is barely recognizable; it scrambles about on all fours, its nails and teeth both sharpened into dangerous-looking spikes.

And though you fight to stay alive,
Your body starts to shiver.
For no mere mortal can resist,
The evil of the thriller.
With a crocodile-like snout and rows of protruding teeth, this swimwear-clad zombie lurks in the water.

Once human, its features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath its large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the surrounding air, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet-black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the surrounding air seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.

At first this creature looks like nothing more than a grotesque and oleaginous husk, bloated and punctured by jet-black pustules.  When approached, its glowing red eyes and an aching grin take form; its skin tears and its guts teem with unmatched fecundity, as its gaze inspires fear of nothing less than cosmic, inhuman ecstasy.
This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.

With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and black ooze seeps out from cuts between its muscles.
A thin corpse, its chest swollen in what appears to be preparation.  A thick black ooze drips from its open mouth.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human-shaped outline.

Living in the woods,
killing for sport,
eating all the bodies--
actual cannibal Shia LaBeouf.
An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.

data.//: Highest upgrade of brainless/ear zombie.  Still immune to headshots, as there's nothing critical there.
data.description: This creature's head is a hideous gray skull, formed of human bone fragments and some sort of goo.  Jagged teeth are visible as the thing works its jaw and disturbingly human, lidless eyes stare at you from their sockets.  The thing's fleshy ears are four sizes too large and droop under their own weight.
A blackened and twisted naked human body.  Strips of flesh hang from its frame, and it emits a constant haze of thick black smoke.

A gigantic, twisted human frame with a menancing stance and rapid movements.  Thick clouds of smoke pour from violent-looking eviscerations spread across its muscular-looking body, and its arms appear to have elongated massively.
A human body, clad in swimwear.  Probably not a very graceful swimmer now, owing to its zombified state.
A slick and glistening human body.  Its hands and feet are heavily webbed, and it is clad in swimwear.
Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.

A shambling undead humanoid, its body overgrown with a tangled mass of otherworldly vegetation.  Hunched over and dragging its feet as it moves, the bramble utterly enveloping its upper half twitches and moves with a life of its own, tendrils tipped with a paralytic sting.
This shambling corpse is dressed in the tatters of an antiquated soldier's uniform.  Either it was a historical reenactor, or zombies have also started to time travel.
Apparently this zombie was doing time when the Cataclysm struck.  It wears black and white striped prisoner clothes, and tattoos can be seen on his decaying skin.
This muscular zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
This fat zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
This tough-looking zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
Intense radiation has spurred a unique form of necrosis and regeneration, it is impossible to tell if this creature was ever human.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the surrounding air.

data.//: Skelly brute gaps the evolution between normal and the juggernaut.
data.description: Distorted outgrowths of calcified bone plates cover this zombie's rotten skin.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with black goo.
Heavy, jagged bone plates have grown out of the surface of this zombie.  Underneath, its flesh glows and crackles with the occasional jolt of electricity.

This hideous golem of plated bones and misshapen flesh drags its heavy, pointed limbs behind it like an unwanted burden.  Formerly soft and vulnerable, bones grew around its form to protect it - only, they kept growing.  And growing.  And growing.
Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.
This soldier zombie's skin radiates a sort of shadowy smoke that obscures its outline, making its camouflage even harder to see against the background.  In the darkness it would be nigh invisible.
Fragments of visible uniform hint that this monstrosity was once a soldier.  Anything human is invisible, hidden inside a sheath of living shadow.  It moves with preternatural fluidity and grace.

This staggering soldier wears a burnt gasmask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask comes some sort of hardened fleshy proboscis, with steaming corrosive fluid leaking from the end.

This zombie wears what appears to have once been a soldier's uniform and armor, now a series of cracked and melted plates that have fused to its skin and thickened hide.  Its face and arms blister with strange mutated tubes that pulse and drip with acid.

special_attacks.description: The %s launches a hail of corrosive darts!

data.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  At this point it's impossible to tell what kind of uniform it was: the monster's skin has grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, turning the remaining Kevlar and other bits of armor material into part of its hide.  Its hands, similarly, have fused into large leathery cudgels.

This zombie was once wearing some kind of now long-shredded uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  It has grown into a hulking, leatherbacked beast, its mutated skin taking on a strange texture similar to the Kevlar bits embedded in it.  Its arms have twisted into enormous clubs of misshapen bone that it drags on the ground behind it.
Once a pilot, it is dressed in basic military fatigues, aviator sunglasses, and a sturdy looking helmet.

When bullets weren't enough to stop the end of the world, the military tried fire instead.  Their failure is made manifest in this gas-masked husk, its black suit torn and ripped.  Its flamethrower, dangling limply at its side, is attached to a tank of napalm strapped onto its back, which trickles its contents onto the ground.
Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable suit of power armor, something still managed to kill this soldier.
This armored and augmented soldier's bionics crackle with energy.  Worse, it appears to remember its training.
Once a highly trained soldier, various bionics cover this zombie's broken body.  Strangely, it maintains a vague martial arts stance.
Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.

This zombie once was a survivor like you, and a pretty good one at that.  Unfortunately they didn't make it, despite the custom-made, heavy armor pieces they wear and the gear that they are still lugging around.

data.name: Any
data.mutagen_message: You feel strange.
data.iv_message: You inject yoursel-arRGH!
data.iv_sleep_message: You writhe and collapse to the ground.

data.name: Plant
data.mutagen_message: You feel much closer to nature.
data.iv_message: You inject some nutrients into your phloem.

data.name: Insect
data.mutagen_message: You hear buzzing, and feel your body harden.
data.iv_message: You sting yourself… for the Queen.

data.name: Spider
data.mutagen_message: You feel insidious.
data.iv_message: Mmm… the *special* venom.
data.memorial_message: Found a place in the web of life.

data.name: Slime
data.mutagen_message: Your body loses all rigidity for a moment.
data.iv_message: This stuff takes you back.  Downright primordial!
data.memorial_message: Gave up on rigid human norms.
data.junkie_message: Maybe if you drank enough, you'd become mutagen…

data.name: Fish
data.mutagen_message: You are overcome by an overwhelming longing for the ocean.
data.iv_message: Your pulse pounds as the waves.

data.name: Rat
data.mutagen_message: You feel a momentary nausea.
data.iv_message: You squeak as the shot hits you.
data.//: Sound of ratlike squeaking

data.name: Beast
data.mutagen_message: Your heart races and you see blood for a moment.
data.iv_message: Your heart races wildly as the injection takes hold.

data.name: Bear
data.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to… patrol?  the forests?
data.iv_message: You feel yourself quite equipped for wilderness survival.

data.name: Feline
data.mutagen_message: As you lap up the last of the mutagen, you wonder why…
data.iv_message: Your back arches as the mutagen takes hold.

data.name: Wolf
data.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to mark your territory.  But then it passes.
data.iv_message: As the mutagen hits you, your ears twitch and you stifle a yipe.

data.name: Cattle
data.//: ~rBGH is a bovine growth hormone, unpopular with consumers
data.mutagen_message: Your mind and body slow down.  You feel peaceful.
data.iv_message: You wonder if this is what rBGH feels like…
data.memorial_message: Stopped worrying and learned to love the cowbell.

data.name: Cephalopod
data.//: ~Zork reference, but it's talking about your blood vessels
data.mutagen_message: Your mind is overcome by images of eldritch horrors… and then they pass.
data.iv_message: You watch the mutagen flow through a maze of little twisty passages.  All the same.

data.name: Bird
data.mutagen_message: Your body lightens and you long for the sky.
data.iv_message: Your arms spasm in an oddly wavelike motion.

data.name: Lizard
data.mutagen_message: For a heartbeat, your blood cools down.
data.iv_message: Your blood cools down.  The feeling is… different.

data.name: Troglobite
data.mutagen_message: You yearn for a cool, dark place to hide.
data.iv_message: As you press the plunger, it all goes so bright…

data.name: Alpha
data.//: 5-15 pain, 66% for each of the follow-ups, so slightly better odds (designed for injection).
data.mutagen_message: You feel… better.  Somehow.
data.iv_message: You took that shot like a champ!
data.//2: Alpha doesn't make a lot of massive morphological changes, so less nutrients needed.

data.name: Medical
data.//: 2-6 pain, same as Alpha--since specifically intended for medical applications.
data.mutagen_message: You can feel the blood rushing through your veins and a strange, medicated feeling washes over your senses.
data.iv_message: You can feel the blood in your medication stream.  It's a strange feeling.
data.//2: Medical's are pretty much all physiology, IIRC
data.junkie_message: Ahh, there it is.  You can feel the mutagen again.

data.name: Chimera
data.//: 24-36 pain, Scream,, -40 Morale, but two guaranteed mutations and 75% each for third and fourth
data.mutagen_message: You need to roar, bask, bite, and flap.  NOW.
data.iv_message: everyanimalthateverlived.bursting.from.YOU!
data.//2: Chimera's all about the massive morphological changes Done Quick, so lotsa nutrition needed
data.iv_sleep_message: With a final *pop*, you go out like a light.

data.name: Fey
data.mutagen_message: Nature is becoming one with you…
data.iv_message: Everything goes green for a second.
data.//: 3-15 pain, morale boost, but no more mutagenic than cat-9s
data.//2: Should be out for two minutes.  Ecstasy Of Green
data.memorial_message: Accepted a more natural way of life.

data.name: Raptor
data.//: Little more painful than average, but nowhere near as harsh & effective as Chimera.
data.mutagen_message: Mmm… sweet, bloody flavor… tastes like victory.
data.iv_message: You distinctly smell the mutagen mixing with your blood… and then it passes.

data.name: Mouse
data.mutagen_message: You feel a desire to curl up in a nice, warm pile of… shredded paper.
data.iv_message: You feel… small.  But comfortable.
